::: {#exr-finite-difference-cost}

#### The cost of finite differences

A finite difference,
$\paren{\loss(\theta_i + \smallconst) - \loss(\theta_i)} / \smallconst$ for a small $\smallconst$,
estimates the derivative of the [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network)'s mean training loss $\loss$ with respect to one [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) $\theta_i$,
with every other parameter held fixed.
How many evaluations of the loss does that take to estimate the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) with respect to $P$ [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter)?

:::
